description: Inline snapshot matchers called from inside other custom matchers (B23e, D128), on a first local run: where each snapshot is written is the frame below the innermost matcher call: jest-snapshot 30.5.2 cuts its stack at the innermost external-matcher trap (`removeLinesBeforeExternalMatcherTrap`, then `getTopFrame` past `node_modules`), and Jest registers its own snapshot matchers with `expect.extend`, so they run inside one too. A custom matcher over jest-snapshot's `toMatchInlineSnapshot`, called through `expect` from another custom matcher, writes into the outer matcher's body in `setup.ts`; so does the built-in `toMatchInlineSnapshot` inside one custom matcher, and two custom matchers down it writes into the inner one's body. The test file is left as it was. `prettierPath: null`, so Babel's reprint alone. One file, one worker.
